predecessors.name: Mexico
predecessors.text: the zone Cliopatria draws for the Maderistas in 1911, about Chihuahua City and the Guerrero district of Chihuahua; neither page names the land

successors.name: Mexico
successors.text: the zone Cliopatria draws for the Maderistas in 1911, about Chihuahua City and the Guerrero district of Chihuahua; neither page names the land

ledger.x: 1911: the Maderista rebels hold a zone in Chihuahua.
April 1911: the Maderistas besiege Ciudad Juárez.
21 May 1911: the Treaty of Ciudad Juárez is signed, which ends the fighting at Ciudad Juárez.
May 1911: the Maderista revolt ends and the zone returns to the federal state.

wars.name: Mexican Revolution
wars.outcome: The Maderista rebels forced the Treaty of Ciudad Juárez on 21 May 1911; Díaz resigned on 25 May and Madero was elected president in October 1911.

certainty.note: A rebel-held zone with no treaty or survey line; the outline is Cliopatria's approximation of the ground the Maderistas held.
